changelog_text:
First public release of the Sterling Orbital Sparrow Launch System for Kitten Space Agency.

**Download `SterlingOrbital_v1.0.0.zip` below** and copy the `SterlingOrbital` folder into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\`, then enable it in `manifest.toml`. The flight software needs the StarMap mod loader.

### Included
- Sparrow reusable two-stage rocket: first stage (clean, sooted and plain liveries), interstage, second stage, payload adapter, fairing, grid fins, landing legs, 24 built-in attitude thrusters
- Anvil 1D sea-level engines
- Octaweb with 9 / 3 / 1 engine sets to ignite
- Anvil Vac upper-stage engine
- Drone ship "It Was Never Goodbye"
- Flight software: mission control panel (Sterling Orbital menu in the top bar, or Ctrl+Shift+F)
- Launch webcast UI
- Automated ascent, boostback or drone ship recovery, entry and landing burns, RECOVER VEHICLE after landing.

### Requirements
- Kitten Space Agency build 2026.11.25.5949 or newer
- StarMap mod loader

### Known limitations
- The guidance system is not perfect, but excitement is guaranteed.
- Automated flights launch from KSC (LC-39A) only in this version
- First-stage soot is not kept when a save is reloaded

### License and source
- Code: MIT. Source: [source/SterlingFlight](https://github.com/SterlingOrbital/SterlingOrbital/tree/main/source/SterlingFlight) in this repo
- Parts, models, textures: CC BY 4.0 (credits in the README)
- Bai Jamjuree font: SIL OFL 1.1
- Full text in `LICENSE` (repository root and inside the mod folder)

See the README for full instructions and credits.

listing.description:
The Sparrow is a reusable two-stage rocket for Kitten Space Agency. The flight software flies the whole mission:
ascent, staging, boostback or drone ship recovery, and a propulsive landing of the first stage.

What's included:

- Parts: first stage (clean and sooted liveries), interstage with built-in attitude thrusters, second stage, payload
  adapter, fairing halves, grid fins, landing legs, the octaweb with nine Anvil 1D engines, and the Anvil Vac
  upper-stage engine.
- The autonomous drone ship "It Was Never Goodbye".
- Flight software: mission control panel (Sterling Orbital menu or Ctrl+Shift+F), launch webcast, booster guidance
  and landing, grid fin aerodynamics, landing leg suspension, engine sets (9 / 3 / 1), first-stage soot after the
  entry and landing burns.

Automated flights launch from KSC (LC-39A) for now.

Parts derived from "Falcon 9 - SpaceX" by Stanley Creative, CC BY 4.0. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Space
Exploration Technologies Corp.
